playstyle.identity: Draven is a cash-in ADC who stacks gold with his passive. Catching spinning axes maximizes his damage and lets him snowball harder than any other ADC.
playstyle.howToPlay: Q makes autos spin - catch the axe landing spot to keep it spinning. W gives speed. E knocks aside and slows. R is global damage. Stack passive gold with Q catches, cash in on kills for massive gold lead. Catch axes, dominate lane.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Draven spikes with his first kill (passive gold) and Infinity Edge. He's strongest when snowballing in early-mid game with gold leads.

passive.name: League of Draven
passive.summary: Catching axes and kills stack Adoration; kills cash in for bonus gold.
passive.details: Draven gains Adoration stacks when catching axes or killing minions. Killing champions cashes in stacks for massive bonus gold. Dying loses stacks.

abilities.name: Spinning Axe
abilities.summary: Auto attacks spin, dealing bonus damage. Catch the axe to keep it spinning.
abilities.details: Draven's next auto attack becomes a Spinning Axe that deals bonus damage. The axe bounces to a landing spot - catching it resets Spinning Axe.

abilities.name: Blood Rush
abilities.summary: Gain attack speed and movement speed; refreshes on axe catch.
abilities.details: Draven gains bonus movement and attack speed that decay over time. Catching a Spinning Axe refreshes Blood Rush's cooldown.

abilities.name: Stand Aside
abilities.summary: Throw axes that knock enemies aside and slow them.
abilities.details: Draven throws his axes in a line, dealing damage, knocking enemies aside, and slowing them.

abilities.name: Whirling Death
abilities.summary: Throw global axes that damage enemies and return to you.
abilities.details: Draven hurls two massive axes globally, dealing damage to enemies hit. Axes return to Draven after hitting an enemy champion or reaching the edge of the map.
